# AudioVisual Nepal — https://www.audiovisualnepal.com

Nepal's professional audio-visual solutions provider: design, supply and installation
of PA systems, voice evacuation (EN54), IP network audio, video conferencing,
smart podiums and LED displays across Nepal. Brands: DSPPA, InfoBit, Tenveo, Evolve Podium, Lampro (LED), Wincomn/Krinda (laser projectors),
Triolion (LCD video walls & controllers) and itc (professional sound: line arrays, amplifiers,
mixers, microphones).
